vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: flye-image-clarity-enhance
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle defines a standard integration with the Flyelep AI image enhancement API (flyelep.cn). The instructions in SKILL.md correctly guide the agent to perform HTTP POST requests using a user-provided API key and explicitly advise against hardcoding sensitive credentials, demonstrating good security practices without any signs of malicious intent or data exfiltration.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions and requirements are internally consistent with an API-based image enhancement tool; it asks the caller to supply a Flyelep secretKey at runtime and does not request unrelated system access.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description match the SKILL.md: it calls a Flyelep image clarity enhancement HTTP API and returns enhanced image URLs. No unrelated binaries, files, or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md confines actions to constructing an HTTP POST to the documented Flyelep endpoint, building the imgUrls string and enhanceStrength parameter, and returning the returned URLs. It does not instruct reading local files, environment secrets, or other system state.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code is present (instruction-only), so nothing is written to disk or fetched during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime requires a Flyelep API 'secretKey' sent in the request header, which is proportionate to the stated purpose. However, the skill metadata declares no required env vars or primary credential; the SKILL.md expects the caller to provide the secretKey at runtime (not as an environment variable). This is a documentation/metadata mismatch but not necessarily malicious.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install-time persistence or modification of other skills is requested. The skill does not request elevated or permanent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill simply describes how to call Flyelep's image clarity API and expects you to provide your Flyelep secretKey when calling. Before enabling/using it: (1) Confirm you trust Flyelep and understand their privacy/data-retention policy because images (or image URLs) are sent to their service; (2) Provide the secretKey at runtime rather than embedding it in the skill files — the SKILL.md explicitly warns against persisting the key; (3) Ensure the image URLs you send are public direct-image links and meet the documented size/format limits; (4) Be aware of potential costs or rate limits for bulk processing and long timeouts; (5) Note the minor metadata mismatch — the skill does not declare the secretKey as a required env var even though the instructions require it at runtime — this is likely just documentation practice, but you may want to confirm how you will supply the key when integrating.
